implemented: Wired the canonical entity::classify_node discriminator into the production Go extract + interface ClassInfo.kind producers (additive kind population). Go has no classes: classify_node now resolves a Go type by the UNDERLYING shape of its type_spec (struct_type -> Struct, interface_type -> Interface, other defined type -> Class) and by the dedicated type_alias node (type X = Y -> TypeAlias). The type_declaration wrapper drills into its inner spec/alias child. func with receiver -> Method and plain func -> Function continue to classify via the existing string-keyed classify_node_kind path. Single source of truth: no new per-language kind table.
shared_classify_node_wiring: entity.rs::classify_node gained a Go node-aware branch (gated on Language::Go) plus a private go_type_node_kind(node) helper that inspects the type_spec `type` field. classify_node_kind (string-only) is UNCHANGED, so all Stage-2 string-keyed consumers (function_finder, ast_utils, the classify_definition_node agreement test) stay byte-identical (Struct/Interface/TypeAlias/Class are all class-axis, matching the prior Struct mapping's axis).
json_delta: extract.classes[].kind: Go struct-type carriers now emit "struct" and interface-type carriers now emit "interface" (were: field omitted via skip_serializing_if, kind:None). interface.classes[].kind: Go containers now emit "struct" / "interface" / "class" (a defined type such as `type Celsius float64` -> "class", matching structure's legacy default) where the field was previously omitted. Purely ADDITIVE — no name/line/construct dropped, no existing value changed. structure command output UNCHANGED (its entry-kind switch still reports the class-axis default "class" for Go type_specs and was intentionally not modified). Other 15 languages UNCHANGED (Go-gated). Go `type X = Y` aliases are still dropped by interface's pre-existing type_spec-only name resolver (orthogonal to this additive slice; classify_node nonetheless classifies type_alias -> "type" for the day the collector is widened).
